findings.title: Tool-bearing delivery guard runs after the last complete byte freshness witness
findings.path: Each caller checks bound source/candidate/evidence bytes, then invokes delivery_guards. That helper replays the preview and p.check_experimental_local_settings, both of which call experimental_native_version/nt.check and read caller tools. The caller does not recheck complete bound bytes after those late callbacks. PRL-only checks cannot establish source/current-candidate freshness.
findings.precise_counterexample: During the final _review_choice material call, after source/evidence/candidate/review-project inventories pass, inject a callback in the last nt.check reached through delivery_guards that appends a newline to the live original source .kicad_pro, then returns unchanged tool hashes. The source project is outside the source route evidence root; its source-route PRL/process guards do not reread that live original PRO. Final material can return and choice can remain disposition_recorded against stale source. Analogously, mutate the fresh export's live candidate during the final delivery_guards call after _check_export's evidence comparison; it can return current=True for changed bytes.
findings.recommended_fix: Separate semantic/tool replay from final PRL-only replay. After the semantic/tool phase, repeat the caller's independently bound source/candidate/receipt/complete-evidence witnesses; finish with the already-bound plot/source/export PRL events without further tool callbacks. Preserve all late non-byte checks.
focused_regressions: Late source PRO mutation during the final tool callback in review-copy and choice refuses or invalidates the positive publication.
Late live export candidate/evidence mutation during the final tool callback in check_export refuses current=True and export publication invalidates.
PRL flag mutations during the new final byte witness are still caught by the final PRL-only pass.
findings.execution_status: Source-derived counterexamples only; no tests or Native executed by reviewer.

resolved_during_review.title: Source Route DRC omitted from final PRL-only census
resolved_during_review.original_gap: Initial delivery_guards recognized only sandboxed DRC argv, while explicit p.route source/refill/final workers use the bare caller CLI prefix.
resolved_during_review.current_readback: Now accepts the exact bare or sandboxed caller-CLI DRC prefixes, replays f.process_check with allowed0/5, and adds each bound source/export DRC event to the final PRL pass.
resolved_during_review.status: source-fixed; reviewer did not execute regression

other_seams_reviewed: Default calls retain empty kwargs and reject native_delivery_context/root experimental markers through existing authority checks.
Explicit caller context, literal full-parity opt-in and exact review/choice/binding/export context remain separate from receipt-selected tools.
Default-only explicit export final-netclasses, exact sandbox plus native_prefix argv, metrics version and stage order are reciprocally checked.
Saved-refill/final fullSCH readers receive the explicit context; unsupported flat-class/pour/strategy paths retain refusal.
Public review/choice/export wrappers retain signal handlers, owned correction paths and elapsed/fullCPU checks; no additional concrete cancellation/default regression found in this bounded read.
limits: One narrow source review; no completed controls rerun, no product or Native qualification, no authentication claim against full history fabrication.
